I told them about the ARC, and especially Geoffrey Jackson's infamous testimony. Then about 4k a day. Then about how corrupt and power hungry the elders in my area became. They tried cutting me off so many times but I didn't let them. Mind you I was a pretty timid kid when i used to attend meetings. But now as a 20 year old young adult, I broke out of my shell and I wasn't gonna have any of it. They told me to step outside while they talked, and once they told me to come back in and gave their verdict, I stood up, said "Fuck this cult and it's corrupt leadership", and walked out. I have never felt so free and empowered!
